title: FP16 multiplier
description: An IEEE binary16 multiplier (1 sign, 5 exponent, 10 fraction bits) with subnormal inputs and outputs, round to nearest even, canonical quiet NaN for invalid operations. The starting point is a plain readable Verilog implementation: unpack, 11x11-bit significand multiply, leading-zero count, normalise, round, pack.
flow: Yosys synthesis and OpenROAD static timing analysis on ASAP7. Correctness is proven, not sampled: every evaluation checks the design for formal equivalence with the reference multiplier (yosys-abc cec) and re-simulates the gate-level netlist on about 18.9 million enumerated operand pairs (every subnormal or zero operand against structured partners, plus LFSR-driven broad pairs).
footnotes: All entries were called through OpenRouter without prompt caching, so every step pays for its full input.
